concept.reason: Real scaled fossils, specimen-linked measurements and published complete dorsal/ventral interpretation suffice.

scope: Complete Carboniferous Pygocephalus living interpretation anchored to GSC12858 and same-publication Canadian appendages; not an isolated shield, not a claim of definitive revised species diagnosis.

scientific_limits.en: Canadian P.cooperi identification follows Laville et al2026; later2026 reassessment revises historical shield interpretations, so species-level ornamentation remains uncertain. GSC12858 measurements are real published data; abdomen, living depth and pose are approximate. Main paper locality age wording and Figure2 caption conflict; only Carboniferous is asserted.
scientific_limits.zh: 加拿大材料按Laville等2026鉴定为P.cooperi；后续2026修订指出历史背甲解释问题，因此种级饰纹仍存疑。GSC12858尺度来自真实公开数据，腹部比例、活体厚度及姿势为估计。论文产地年代正文与图2题注不一致，仅主张石炭纪。

taxon: Pygocephalus; Canadian material identified as P. cooperi by Laville et al.2026

scale.uncertainty: First five values bound to GSC12858 data, rounded precision is not added accuracy. Wholebody excludes antennae and limbs, estimated about44mm; missing body depth and appendage posture inferred.

anatomy: Broad nearly circular shield, wider than long, short straight rostrum about0.26shieldlength, smaller paired anterolateral spines, curved lateral outline and concave posterior margin. Canadian reference lacks obvious lateral spine row; do not add unrelated species ornament.

Eight thoracic appendage pairs: first two compact feeding-associated pairs with enlarged bases; pairs3-8 longer walking limbs, increasing posteriorly. Do not model eight equal longlegs or modern five-pair decapod.

Six broad abdominal tergites with compact ringed profile, followed by distinct hexagonal telson. Uropods paired oval blades; telson bears two pairs of small ellipsoidal lobes plus central terminalspine, not onepair as Anthracaris.

Two paired anterior antennal systems, long fine flagella and flattened scaphocerites; small eyes conservatively reconstructed from2022species diagram, not declared preserved inGSC12858. Ventral firsttwo sternites obscured by feeding bases, later sternites broaden posteriorly.
restoration_boundaries: GSC12858 Figure2 is actual anchor, published numerical table linked directly by Zenodo GSC12858.csv. Figure2A bar5mm; detailbars3mm. Do not turn displaced broken fragment gaps into living anatomy.
GSC12810 and12811 Figure3 are same-paper appendage comparators, not the sameindividual;5mm bars separate. Preserve this composite boundary.

2022 Figure10 onlyD/F target dorsal and putative male ventral interpretation;A-C are Anthracaris. E is female with broodplates, not our default. Old dotted dorsal ornament is not copied over the smoother Canadian anchor.
Later Astrop2026 taxonomy article indexed text obtained but fullpage403; no bypass or claim fullrevision checked. Keep genus-level product name and explicit species determination uncertainty.
Paper Figure2 caption says lateVisean-Serpukhovian/Mabou, studiedmaterial text saysBashkirian/Parrsboro. Do not invent reconciliation or exactage. Carboniferous satisfies original scope.
Living depth, regularized symmetry, softparts and muted color are interpretive. No borrowed texture or copied scientific mesh.
